title: Decent sheets
text: Decent sheets. These are pretty decent sheets, I like the pattern and they are really soft and comfortable. I normally have problems finding sheets for this bed because the mattress is pretty deep, but this does fit on the mattress just fine. Honestly, my biggest complaint about these sheets is that the fitted sheet didn’t hold its elasticity that great, so if you are someone who moves around a lot while you sleep you might have issues with the fitted sheet popping off.
